name: overview
description: A small dashboard beside the chat: Claude's progress and helpers drawn as avatars, the steps only you can take, and a queue of ideas Claude clarifies, files and works through alone

pickupAfterSeconds.title: Pick up ticked steps after (seconds)
pickupAfterSeconds.description: How long after your last tick Claude, if idle, starts on its own to confirm your ticked steps. 0: never on its own, only with your next message.

phoneAlerts.title: Phone alerts for your steps
phoneAlerts.description: Tell your phone when Claude adds a step only you can take, or reopens one (sent only when you are away from the session).

autoStartSeconds.title: Start the next queued task after (seconds)
autoStartSeconds.description: Once Claude has finished and nothing else is open, how long the pane counts down before it starts the next ready task of Up next by itself. 0: never by itself, only with Start now.
